name: 8-Week Strong & Safe Online Private Program
tagline: Injury-aware Classical Pilates, one to one, from home.
whoItsFor: Your back, neck, shoulders or knees have been holding you back
You feel stiff, or you're careful around an old injury
You're hypermobile and want strength you can rely on
Group classes move too fast, or you're not sure what is right for your body
Your doctor or physical therapist has cleared you for exercise
notForHeading: This is not the right fit if
notFor: You've had surgery in the last 6 months and your doctor has not cleared you for exercise
You have a serious medical condition and have not been cleared for exercise
You're looking for medical care. Pilates is exercise, and it works alongside your doctor or PT, not instead of them

included.title: 1 online assessment (75 minutes)
included.detail: We meet live on video. I watch how you move, listen to your history, and we set the goals for your 8 weeks.

included.title: 7 private online sessions (60 minutes each)
included.detail: Just you and me, once a week. Every session is planned for your body and adjusted as you get stronger.

included.title: A written weekly plan
included.detail: A short, clear plan after each session so you know exactly what to practice between our meetings.

included.title: Session recordings
included.detail: Our sessions are on Zoom and recorded. I send you the recording so you can revisit the cues at home.

included.title: Weekly check-in by WhatsApp or text
included.detail: A quick message from me each week to see how your body is feeling and answer questions.

included.title: The private Skool hub
included.detail: Access to Strong & Safe Pilates Online, the private hub where your plans and resources live.

howItWorks.title: Week 1. Your assessment
howItWorks.detail: A 75-minute session on video. We look at how you move today and agree on what matters most to you.

howItWorks.title: Weeks 2 to 8. Your private sessions
howItWorks.detail: One 60-minute session each week, live online. We build strength and control step by step, always within what feels safe for you.

howItWorks.title: Between sessions. Your weekly plan
howItWorks.detail: A short written plan to practice at home, plus a check-in from me by WhatsApp or text.

howItWorks.title: Week 8. Where you are now
howItWorks.detail: We look back at where you started, what has changed, and how to keep going.

equipment: A mat, or a carpeted floor
Enough room to lie down and stretch your arms and legs out
A phone, tablet or laptop with a camera

instructor.heading: Your teacher
instructor.name: Diana Gonçalves
instructor.credential: Classical Pilates instructor. Romana's Pilates International Certification, 900 hours.
instructor.bio: I teach the classical method the way it was passed down, with close attention to your body and your history. I've worked with beginners, athletes, clients in their nineties, hypermobile bodies and people coming back after an injury. My job is to meet you where you are and help you build strength you can trust.
instructor.photoAlt: Diana Gonçalves smiling, arms resting on the ladder barrel

faq.q: Is this medical care or physical therapy?
faq.a: No. Pilates is exercise. I don't diagnose or treat anything. I plan careful, injury-aware sessions and I'm happy to work alongside the advice of your doctor or physical therapist.

faq.q: Do I need to be cleared for exercise?
faq.a: Yes. If you have an injury, a recent surgery or a medical condition, please get the OK from your doctor or PT before we start. If you are not sure, ask them first. Your place will be here when you're ready.

faq.q: I've never done Pilates. Is that OK?
faq.a: Absolutely. Many of my clients start as complete beginners. Everything is taught step by step and adapted to you.
A mat or a carpeted floor, enough space to lie down with your arms and legs stretched out, and a device with a camera. That's all.

faq.q: How do the online sessions work?
faq.a: We meet live on video. You set your camera so I can see your whole body, and I coach you in real time, just like in the studio.

guarantee.heading: My promise to you
guarantee.text: Every session is planned for your body, not pulled from a template. If something doesn't feel right, we stop, adjust and find another way. You'll always know why we're doing what we're doing.

disclaimer: Pilates is exercise, not medical care. This program does not diagnose, treat or cure any condition. Please check with your doctor or physical therapist before starting any exercise program, and stop any movement that causes sharp or unusual pain.
